Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a significant shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the left (contralateral side), which is the classic presentation of a massive pleural effusion exerting mass effect. Atelectasis would cause an ipsilateral (rightward) shift, and pneumonia typically does not cause such a profound mediastinal shift without volume loss or gain.
